title: UK Billionaire: “Decarbonize 0r Die”
author: Robert Hunziker
content:
![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/chris-
leboutillier-TUJud0AWAPI-unsplash-1-680x453.jpg)

Image by Chris LeBoutillier.

It’s almost a foregone conclusion that UK billionaire Chris Hohn has not
fallen for one of Donald Trump’s cons, like investing in a stupid coin that
says, ‘fight, fight, fight’. OMG, what’s with these billionaire suck-ups that
fall for Trump’s juvenile gold bricks, only fitting for The Gong Show
(1976-80).

A recent interview of billionaire Chris Hohn in The Times d/d August 8, 2026,
_Chris Hohn, Britain’s Greenest Billionaire: “It’s Decarbonize or Die_ ”
explains his understanding of the climate crisis. And he puts his money where
his mouth is by topping “The Times’ Giving List” with donations of £1.4
billion ($1.9B) for the environment as well as other social welfare causes.

Hohn’s opening statements: “It is blindingly obvious that the world is getting
warmer. Any idiot can see that the climate has changed and climate change is
accelerating. Anybody who doesn’t look at the science is willfully ignorant.”
Probably another reason why he likely doesn’t cater to Trump’s “money for
favors” schemes. It’s what the presidency is all about? Umm, sure!

Hohn is the founder of TCI Fund Management, £60 billion in assets. He’s likely
the first, and maybe only, billionaire to publicly admit we’ve screwed up the
climate system, badly!

He’s a decarbonizing fanatic: “If you aren’t decarbonizing your business, you
could go out of business. Some car manufacturers are still only making the
internal combustion engine — and they will go to the death making the internal
combustion engine. In Europe when that’s banned, which is just a matter of
time, then you’ll be bankrupt. If you’re a shareholder in that car company,
you should be encouraging and pressuring the management to wake up and smell
the coffee.”

Meanwhile, the UK’s Labor Party leader, who is now Prime Minister Andy
Burnham, effective July 20, 2026, has already decided (most likely) to open
drilling in the North Sea. His new energy secretary indicating they might need
to “relax some net-zero targets” to get the job done with finances tight, and
so forth??? Yet, interestingly, confusingly, since taking power in 2024, the
Labour Party introduced a wide range of energy policies supporting renewable
energy development and grid infrastructure updates, as well as restrictions on
new oil and gas drilling.

According to [LBC News:](https://www.lbc.co.uk/article/andy-burnham-calls-
block-north-sea-drilling-after-fires-5Hjdg52_2/) “Mr. Burnham has faced
pressure from Washington DC to approve drilling in the North Sea. US president
Donald Trump claimed that not allowing new drilling would leave the UK as a
‘bankrupt country’ but added he thought Mr. Burnham was going to open up oil
and gas fields.”

And, it seems like only yesterday that The Times exposed the previous PM
Starmer’s administration of suppressing an absolutely devastating report by
the combined efforts of the UK military, aka: His Majesty’s Armed Forces and
intelligence units MI5, MI6, stating that climate change’s destruction of
ecosystems was leading to (1) severe food shortages (2) mass migrations and
(3) dangerous geopolitical conflicts, within the next five years. This
shockingly short timeline to some level of cataclysmic purgatory should be
ringing bells on the town square and activating ear-screeching alarms
throughout the land. See- [The Most Shocking Climate News of
2026.](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/08/04/the-most-shocking-climate-news-
of-2026/)

However, with that redlight warning now in the public domain, the authorities
are looking in the opposite direction, away from a “baked-in UK” to counteract
the punishing extreme heat by questionably increasing the impact of CO2 on
global warming via drilling in the North Sea; it’ll crank up heat even more.
It’s complicated!

Yet the world community sees it differently, Covering Climate Now’s [89
Percent Project](https://89percent.org/) spotlights the reality that 80 to 89
percent of the world’s people want their governments to take stronger climate
action (a tipoff for aspiring political campaigns). “A representative survey
across 125 countries, interviewing nearly 130,000 individuals’ findings reveal
widespread support for climate action. Notably, 69% of the global population
expresses a willingness to contribute 1% of their personal income, 86% endorse
pro-climate social norms and 89% demand intensified political action.”
(_Globally Representative Evidence on the Actual and Perceived Support for
Climate Action_ , [Nature Climate
Change](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41558-024-01925-3), February 9, 2024)

Alas, seventy-five percent (75%) of England and all (100%) of Wales are in
severe drought, parched as far as the eye can see. Is there anybody in the
world who doesn’t understand the relationship between excessive greenhouse gas
(GHG) CO2 and global warming? Just wondering?

**Decarbonize or Die**

In stark contrast to the jaw-dropping insanity of Hohn’s home government
possibly cranking up North Sea oil targets, especially in the context of an
ecosystem-killer called ‘heat’ on the loose throughout the countryside, Hohn
is adamant that the drive for Net Zero is the right course: “It is a case of
decarbonize or die,’ he says, ’If you don’t embrace green technologies, there
will be no jobs because that’s the future. All these people who say we can’t
afford net zero — they’re completely misunderstanding the gravity of the
situation. In fact, it’s the opposite. You can’t afford not to act because of
the impact on food prices and energy prices. The more we use fossil fuels, the
more it will drive up prices,” Ibid.

Casting a dark shadow over the entire global warming complex, most (almost
all) of the 195 governments that firmly committed to cut CO2 emissions by
30-50% by 2030 at the landmark Paris 2015 UN climate conference have cut back,
partially or in many cases entirely, on their commitments, and large donations
by philanthropic foundations have scaled back ever since, and before, Trump
uttered “drill baby drill.” Trump is likely the biggest promoter of dangerous
climate change in political history; he’s the Genghis Khan of Disruptive
Climate Change.

Counterintuitively, the worse climate change gets, the more advocates for
doing something constructive turn tail. “A greenwashing survey of more than
3,500 companies with climate commitments has found that nearly all of them —
96 percent of the sample — fall short on at least one risk indicator. The
study, which the authors say is the largest of its kind, paints a bleak
picture of corporate climate pledges.” (Greenwashing Risk is Widespread,
Survey of 3,500 Companies Finds, Trellis – Data-Driven EnviroLab, University
of North Carolina, March 5, 2026)

Moreover, with only a handful of the 195 countries that agreed to cut
emissions at Paris 2015 ‘maybe’ meeting their CO2 commitments, this digression
also registers with the public mindset, tossing in the towel on mitigation
measures: “Americans Are Increasingly Pessimistic About Avoiding the Effects
of Climate Change,” Pew Research Center, May 28, 2026.

**Extinction Rebellion ‘Wakes Up’ UK**

Mr. Hohn proudly admits to funding Extinction Rebellion (XR), a high-profile
global nonviolent movement to compel the world to address the climate and
ecological emergency co-founded by Roger Hallam, with a personal donation
(Hohn) of £50,000 plus CIFF (Hohn’s Children’s Investment Fund Foundation)
giving an additional £150,000 alongside commitments by The Climate Emergency
Fund (CEF) co-founded by heiress Aileen Getty with a commitment by Hollywood
director of _Don’t Look Up_(2021) Adam McKay ($4M to CEF), [The Gargantuan Lie
That is Collapsing the World’s
Climate,](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/the-massive-climate-lie-that-
will-destroy-human-
civilization?fbclid=IwY2xjawTjOg5wZG9mAWV4dG4DYWVtAjExAGJyaWQRMWh2eER6bmxoWEVIc1BSemVzcnRjBmFwcF9pZBAyMjIwMzkxNzg4MjAwODkyAAEeBHedA1sIRVoQfj1piJE5e5tHZUgJygWi4zsk_71Af7tvmBJ8dX2w62mpevA_aem_8YqG5aTi_vEta1lubIiQ2w)
Current Affairs, August 6, 2026. He wrote a brilliant article.

“I’m not ashamed to say that I funded them for public awareness-raising
because a lot of people have been asleep on this issue. We didn’t support
anything illegal, but they did an important job in their peaceful work in
raising public awareness.” (Hohn)

In 2022 Roger Hallam was sentenced to five years in prison (later reduced to 4
years) for “conspiracy to cause a public nuisance” because “he spoke on a Zoom
call to help organize a nonviolent protest.” It was one of the longest
sentences for non-violent (peaceful) protests in UK history. No further
comment needed!

Roger Hallam Interview: _Democracy Necessitates Resistance (w/Roger
Hallam)_[The Chris Hedges
Report,](https://chrishedges.substack.com/p/democracy-necessitates-resistance)
July 17, 2026.
